rp_fpga_jtag_followup.crystal_keepout: No new F.Cu track or via within the three keepout boxes around X201, C2020, C2021, R2002 and the XIN/XOUT traces south of the U201 pad row. power_fault_screen_followup.screen: tools/check_power_copper.py at the exact 1.35 A static maximum (not rounded): 0 failures. +3V3_LOGIC fault rise 39.0 C track / 62.7 C neck / 84.7 C via; +3V3_STORAGE 27.0 C track / 43.4 C via; limits 45 C, necks and vias 90 C. The 2.5 A screen of the TPS62162 gave 138 entries. Margin: the screen passes up to about 1.386 A (2.7 % above 1.35 A); rounding up to 1.4 A would fail the 87 single +3V3_LOGIC plane-to-pad vias at about 92 C. The checker models ten 0.1-0.25 mm staircase pieces between C2017.1 and C2001.1 as zero-length nodes.
power_fault_screen_followup.preservation: design/power-fault-screen-2026-10-23/preservation-check.json: every footprint (pads, nets, positions), zone and track/via of 6d50fc5 unchanged apart from the three reviewed widths and the note text; no copper added or removed. U21/U22 change value, MPN and datasheet fields only. One widened link runs between R2038's pads with 0.14 mm clearance.
power_fault_screen_followup.budgets: Logic 0.35 A and storage 0.5 A budgets; peak inductor current about 0.61 A at 5 V input against the 0.85 A minimum limit. TI suggests 3.3 uH for low input voltage to reach the full 0.5 A; regulation at the hold-up minimum remains a bench item.
